top_signals.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf
top_signals.summary: Bessent’s effort to tamp down long-term Treasury yields could force Warsh to clarify how far the Fed should go in coordinating on bonds and the balance sheet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: De olho nas eleições no Brasil
top_signals.summary: O repórter Daniel Carvalho conta mais detalhes do debate no TSE sobre o uso de inteligência artificial nas campanhas eleitorais. Com produção de Rafaela Duarte e edição de Raphael Almeida (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
